---
applyTo: "**/*.md"
---

# Section for academic purpose only

Este tipo de  ficheros matchean vs un path o tipo de documento específico.
Sirven para dar instrucciones de estilo o contenido para ese tipo de documentos. 
En este caso, el patrón es `**/*.md`, lo que significa que se aplicarán a todos los archivos 
Markdown en el repositorio.


# Markdown instructions

- Write concise, structured Markdown.
- Prefer clear headings over long paragraphs.
- Use short bullet lists when they improve readability.
- Keep terminology consistent across documents.
- When documenting code changes, include purpose, scope, and impact.
- When documenting APIs, include request shape, response shape, and error cases.
- When documenting infrastructure, include affected resources, environments, and risks.
- Do not invent file paths, commands, or APIs that are not present in the repository.
- Prefer copy-paste friendly examples.
